Current user direction

User correction 2026-09-12 supersedes earlier ownership framing: Eidolon is an early-stage idea and is not a current focus. This P3 proposal imposes no architecture, module retirement, migration or dependency requirement on ScalaFIM. Keep it dormant unless concrete native correctness/performance/API needs or an explicitly adopted consumer justify reopening implementation. Core ScalaFIM work and PHRF proceed independently. Historical ADR/RFE text is retained as proposal history, not binding authority.

Historical proposal

Update docs/module-relations.md and related architecture material after the boundary RFEs settle.

Required content:
- Canonical dependency direction gale -> scalafim -> eidolon.
- Scalafim ownership: reusable scientific types, algorithms, model/specification compilers, visualization primitives, and format/interpreter adapters.
- Eidolon ownership: persisted typed workflow graphs, module registry/product metadata, planning/scheduling, cache/materialization/publication state, run lifecycle, and application provenance.
- Explicit statement that scalafim has no build dependency on eidolon.
- Migration disposition for scalafim.pipeline and each fmri-workflow concern.
- The two adapter seams: checked eidolon inputs to scalafim plans, and scalafim outputs to eidolon artifact publication.
- Links to upstream RFEs and eidolon ADR 0001/tracking issue bd-01KXYH4NRMFGV41W48AD6N5Y0P.

Acceptance: module-relations documentation is consistent with build edges and no longer presents pipeline/fmri-workflow as product workflow authority.
set.title: [DORMANT PROPOSAL] Document cross-project boundaries only after concrete adoption
